name: doc-problem-statement
description: Writes a Problem Statement naming who has the problem and in what situation, the evidence and cost behind it, what success looks like, and one "how might we" line. Use for "run doc-problem-statement", "write the problem statement", "what problem are we solving", "leadership saw a demo and wants it shipped", "the prototype is replacing the why", "frame the problem before the spec", "how might we", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
